speaker: A. W. Tozer
title: The chief end of man and restless hearts
text: Man's chief End is to glorify God and enjoy Him forever. God formed us for His pleasure, and so formed us that we can in divine communion enjoy the sweet and mysterious mingling of kindred personalities. The life of man away from the Presence is wrenched loose from that 'blissful center' which is our right and proper dwelling place, the loss of which is the cause of our unceasing restlessness.
modern_interpretation: Our deepest human yearning and inherent purpose lie in connecting with something transcendent and experiencing profound joy in that communion. We were fundamentally designed for this intimate spiritual relationship, and when we disconnect from this 'blissful core' – our true spiritual home – it manifests as a persistent, unsettling restlessness or an unfulfilled longing that pervades our lives.
summary: Humanity's ultimate purpose is to glorify and find eternal joy in God, for which we were created to experience divine communion. Our relentless inner restlessness stems directly from being disconnected from this 'blissful center,' which is our rightful spiritual dwelling.
actionable_advice: Regularly engage in practices like meditation, contemplative prayer, or nature immersion to consciously seek and reconnect with your inner 'blissful center' or a sense of divine presence.
embedding_ready_text: A. W. Tozer teaches that humanity's ultimate purpose is to glorify God and enjoy divine communion, for which we were uniquely formed. This wisdom directly addresses feelings of restlessness, longing, unfulfillment, and spiritual disconnection, explaining that our existential dread and lack of meaning arise when we are wrenched from our 'blissful center' – our true spiritual home. A modern interpretation suggests our deepest human yearning is for transcendent connection and joy, and without it, we experience persistent unease. This profound truth offers guidance in devotion and self-inquiry, providing a path to overcome chronic unhappiness and purpose confusion by consciously reconnecting with a higher source, cultivating inner peace, and rediscovering our authentic spiritual identity.
